$comment: One view folder = one lazy bundle (dist/views/<folder>.js). The build registers every type listed here; docs/CONTRACT.md §1.

views.name: Chart
views.summary: Any Vega-Lite chart of the view's rows: presets per .base, an Encode menu, a hover card with the photo, Ashby envelopes and index lines, the same rows as a table one click away.

views.name: Time series
views.summary: Series over t, Tremor's frameless look: target dashed, bands, rules and annotations; on the dashboard's clock a playhead, a shared crosshair readout and brush-to-zoom (PEP 0005); interactive: true is the Foxglove/Rerun plot on uPlot (pan, zoom x/y/box, legend hide/isolate, ? help, maximise), loaded only then.

views.name: Trajectory
views.summary: 2D paths against a target at equal aspect, with a tolerance tube, start and end marks, and a marker and trail per path that follow the clock (PEP 0005).
